title: WeatherResult
description: The 'result' payload shape when ProviderResponseEnvelope.capability='weather' (Checkpoint Phase 4 C.0, docs/adr/0009-phase4-checkpointc0-live-data-and-react-design.md). Explicitly distinguishes a forecast, a current observation, historical data, and an unavailable result via 'kind' -- a caller must never infer freshness from field presence alone. freshness/provenance/retrieved_at live on the enclosing ProviderResponseEnvelope, not duplicated here. schema_version 1.1.0 (Checkpoint Phase 4 C.1, docs/adr/0010-phase4-checkpointc1-openmeteo-weather-adapter.md) additively introduces optional 'requested_location', 'country', 'resolved_latitude', 'resolved_longitude', and 'attribution' -- needed once a real geocoding-backed adapter (Open-Meteo) exists to resolve a free-text location and to carry the provider's own attribution/licence notice. Every existing 1.0.0 instance (none of these fields set) remains valid unchanged.

requested_location.description: 1.1.0+ only. The original, unmodified location string the caller supplied -- preserved even when 'location' below reflects a geocoded/resolved name that differs from it.

country.description: 1.1.0+ only. The resolved country name or code, present only when a geocoding step actually supplied one.

attribution.description: 1.1.0+ only. Present whenever the provider's own terms require attribution -- e.g. Open-Meteo's CC BY 4.0 licence notice. Never fabricated when a provider has no such requirement.

timezone.description: IANA time zone database name (e.g. 'Europe/Istanbul'), never a raw UTC offset -- the offset itself can change with DST. 'UTC' is accepted as the one special-case bare identifier without a '/' (a genuinely valid zoneinfo name, and the honest fallback when no more specific zone could be resolved).

issued_at.description: The provider's own forecast/observation issue time -- distinct from the envelope's retrieved_at (when we fetched it). Absent when kind='unavailable'.

forecast_days.description: Present for kind='forecast' or kind='historical'; empty for 'current_observation'/'unavailable'.

missing_fields.description: Explicitly names any field a caller might expect but this response could not populate -- never silently omitted without a reason recorded here.
